async function haveEightIronOreIntoIronIngots(bot) {
    // This function aims to ensure the bot possesses at least eight iron ingots. It first checks if the required number of ingots is already present. If not, it attempts to gather the necessary iron ore, either by mining nearby blocks or by searching the environment. It then ensures a furnace is available, crafting one if necessary. Finally, it secures enough fuel and smelts the gathered ore to produce the target amount of iron ingots.
